title: Echomaze
tagline: Bounce through the dark maze to the exit

fr.tagline: Deux secondes pour voir le labyrinthe, puis le noir total. Tire des impulsions pour l’écholocaliser.

en.tagline: Two seconds to see the labyrinth, then total darkness. Fire pulses to echolocate it.

description: An electric labyrinth is powered up for two seconds — the only look you ever get at it. Then everything goes out: the maze, the six mouths along its floor, even the walls of the arena. Fire pulses up into a mouth and the board exists only where one just hit it, arcing white and dying out over a couple of seconds, so you are echolocating a maze you can no longer see. Each mouth is a one-way flap — a pulse pushes through and it drops shut behind — and of the six, one leads to the gate at the top and five are dead ends.
